notes.title: New Patch Full Oculus Support
notes.content:
Today's new patch fixed some problems our players had with the oculus. Light Tracer now supports full oculus + oculus controller support. Thank you for your support!

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31439077/587952e1da6be6a20e3f27e793d726cf8093b0a6.png[/img]

tags.feature: Light Tracer now supports full oculus + oculus controller support.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Light Tracer Princess Side, play the original without VR!!!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are happy to announce Light Tracer has just been updated with a mayor game-changer: Light Tracer [b]Princess Side flatscreen mode![/b]

When starting up the game you can now pick whether you want to play the original VR version or start up the game in the [b] Princess Side full Flatscreen mode [/b], where you can enjoy the classic adventure in a whole new way.

Hope you enjoy and leave some comments in the community HUB for feedback or suggestions!

 

The Team
